headline: CACI International Wins $108 Million U.S. Air Force Financial System Contract
summary: CACI secured a $108 million contract from the U.S. Air Force to support its financial system.
why: CACI International is a major defense contractor providing technology and professional services to branches of the U.S. government and Department of Defense.

impacts.name: CACI International
impacts.why: Securing significant government contracts bolsters future revenue pipelines for defense contractors.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
